meta.name: Restore Photo (MOSS, experimental)
meta.licenseNote: MOSS-Image-Base is Apache-2.0 (OpenMOSS). The restore LoRA the request brings is the user's own: NO8D's MOSS HighQuality (Civitai 2436859) allows no commercial use and no derivatives. The app ships no weights.
meta.notes: Runs natively (genai-native gn-diffusion moss-image/restore). An edit of MOSS-Image-Base in ai-toolkit's edit layout (ostris' ComfyUI-MOSS-Image-Ostris-Edit with kv_cache), for an edit LoRA trained there that the request names in `loras`: the picture at the output's size (about 1 MP) encoded by the FLUX.2 VAE and run once through the DiT at t = 0 (frame 1, at the prompt's text index), the encoder seeing the picture too ("Picture 1: <vision>" ahead of the prompt, Qwen3.5's vision tower on the picture fitted to 384² pixels), 9 Euler steps on the shift-5 schedule at CFG 1, the prompt may be empty. Experimental: on no page.
